# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 25 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 35 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_025_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 25

**1** Jesus said: "Love [ме] your brother [сон] like your soul [юхн]. Guard him [аре] like the apple [вал] of your eye [вал]."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *ме*: to love; the command
- *сон*: brother; also "neighbor" in broader usage; the community member
- *юхн*: soul, life-force; love him as you love your own inner being
- *вал*: eye; "apple of the eye" — literally "the eye of the eye" (the pupil); the most vulnerable and precious organ
- *аре*: to guard, watch over (same verb as Sayings 10 and 21)
- cf. Matt 22:39 / Mark 12:31: "Love your neighbor as yourself" — Thomas gives the same commandment with the "apple of the eye" addition
- The double image: love like the soul + guard like the eye's pupil
